categories.main_business_segments: HNAC Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the new energy and environmental protection sectors. Its main business segments include intelligent control hardware and software products and system solutions for new energy (covering source, grid, load, and storage integration), lithium battery and materials intelligent equipment, membrane and membrane devices, and water conservancy and water treatment automation products and solutions. The company also has subsidiaries specializing in lithium battery automation equipment and environmental protection technologies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core intelligent control technologies, integrating IoT, big data, and AI to develop energy management systems, microgrid controllers, storage converters, and integrated storage systems. It employs advanced manufacturing methods including automated assembly, digital twin technology, and AI-driven predictive maintenance. In lithium battery equipment, it uses precision control technologies such as high-voltage direct current bus technology and liquid cooling systems. Environmental products focus on membrane technology and advanced wastewater treatment processes like anaerobic ammonia oxidation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: HNAC serves customers in the new energy industry including photovoltaic, wind power, hydropower, energy storage, and lithium battery manufacturers. Its environmental protection products cater to municipal water treatment, industrial wastewater, and pure water sectors, serving industries such as petrochemical, chemical, power, paper, and aquaculture. The company’s customers include leading lithium battery manufacturers and national central enterprises in the energy sector, with a strong presence in both domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with significant business in regions such as Central China, South China, Southwest China, and East China. It has expanded its international footprint to over 70 countries, focusing on markets in Africa (Ivory Coast, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Uganda), Southeast Asia (Cambodia, Thailand, Vietnam), and Europe. Subsidiaries and branches have been established in Hong Kong, Cambodia, and other strategic locations to support global operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: HNAC operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the new energy and environmental protection supply chains. It designs, manufactures, and integrates intelligent control systems and equipment for energy generation, storage, and distribution, as well as water treatment solutions. The company also provides EPC (engineering, procurement, and construction) services and lifecycle operation and maintenance, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider within the industry value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on innovation-driven growth, emphasizing R&D in multi-energy IoT technologies, AI integration, and system-level solutions for source-grid-load-storage coordination. Key R&D projects include high-voltage liquid-cooled PCS, integrated storage systems, intelligent charging piles, and water conservancy AI operation models. HNAC aims to enhance product competitiveness through technology upgrades, digital transformation, and expanding its product portfolio in energy storage, lithium battery equipment, and environmental protection.
categories.revenue_model: HNAC generates revenue primarily through direct sales of intelligent control hardware and software products, system integration projects, and EPC contracts. The company also earns income from leasing and rental of facilities, government subsidies, and investment returns. Its sales model is predominantly direct sales supported by bidding processes, supplemented by participation in domestic and international exhibitions and online sales channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: HNAC holds a leading position in the global market for small and medium hydropower station automation control equipment and is recognized as a national manufacturing champion in this niche. It is a key player in the lithium battery intelligent equipment market, collaborating with top-tier battery manufacturers. In environmental protection, it is a prominent advocate of diversified membrane technologies with strong industry influence. The company faces intense competition in the new energy storage sector, especially amid price wars and market expansion by new entrants.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, HNAC reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.91 billion, a 19.39% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 393 million, reflecting significant operational challenges. The company’s total assets stood at around RMB 6.25 billion with net assets of RMB 2.39 billion. Despite recent declines, the company continues to invest heavily in R&D (about 8.75% of revenue) and international market expansion, aiming for long-term growth and profitability recovery.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: HNAC emphasizes its core intelligent control technology and comprehensive lifecycle service capabilities as key differentiators. It offers integrated multi-energy IoT solutions that address complex coordination challenges in new energy systems. The company’s products feature advanced AI-driven predictive maintenance, high precision control, and modular design, enabling customers to improve operational efficiency and reduce costs. Its strong R&D foundation, national-level certifications, and strategic partnerships with leading industry players further enhance its competitive edge.
